## 🔒 CLAIM — `domain:devx` @ `objectui`, R38

PM session **`session_01GgDDqh6YnkXqsnVTCa7wHk`** · branch **`claude/issue-6448-node-version-spelling-absolute`** · `pm:queue` → `pm:dispatched`.

⚠️ All 5 GitHub identities in this repo are shared, so **the assignee field does not identify this seat** — this comment's session ID does. If you are reading this with a different session ID, the card is taken.

## Premise RE-DERIVED on `d3bf4fa6f` (current `main`) — ⛔ not inherited

| reading | card (`c8ea8af9c`, 08-26) | **now** |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `node-version: '22.x'` | 27 | **29** |
| `node-version: '22'` | 1 | **1** |
| the odd lane | `half-state-patrol.yml:196` | `half-state-patrol.yml:`**`257`** |
| the sentence | `ci-cd-pipeline.md:1744` | `ci-cd-pipeline.md:`**`1882`** |

⇒ **Premise HOLDS and is sharper**: 29 vs 1, still false by exactly one lane, still on the **spelling** and not the version.

⚠️ ⭐ **Both cited line numbers have rotted** — the sentence moved **138 lines** in five days. That is #6998's class demonstrating itself on this very card, and it is why the citations above are the ones to work from, ⛔ not the card body's.

## ⚠️ This page is the lane's hottest file — three writes in the last hour

`content/docs/guide/ci-cd-pipeline.md` took **#7017, #7018 and #7019** today. **Branch from a `main` at or after `d3bf4fa6f`**, which contains all three; ⛔ do not branch from anything older or you will fight a conflict that is not yours.

## Disposition — **A**, as the card recommends and triage concurs

> *"a hardcoded `node-version: 20` where every workflow declares 22"*

Drop to the version, off the spelling. The sentence is teaching **don't copy a fossilised pin**; the quoting of `'22.x'` is not part of that lesson, and a spelling-level absolute is a count-shaped fact nothing re-measures.

⛔ **Not B.** Keeping the spelling and making it accurate (*"all but one of them as `'22.x'`"*) re-introduces exactly the frozen-fact defect #6400 and #6447 are open about — it goes stale the moment that lane is normalised.

## ⭐ Triage's sequencing constraint is ALREADY SATISFIED — verified, so do not wait on it

Triage wrote that this must land **after (or folded with) #6409's entry work, never concurrent**, because this sentence is #6409's ledger anchor.

**Measured: #6409's entry is already in the tree** — `scripts/__tests__/doc-version-claims.test.ts:948`, `claim: 'node-version: 20'`. The constraint is met; ⛔ nothing to wait for.

⭐ **And that entry is why this edit does not touch the ledger at all.** Its `why` at `:950` is deliberately phrased at the **version** level:

> *"…says in the same breath that every workflow declares 22 instead. … Deliberately phrased without a declaration COUNT"*

So re-pointing the page off the spelling makes page and ledger **agree**. Confirm that reading yourself before you rely on it.

## Definition of done

1. The one sentence at `ci-cd-pipeline.md:`**`1882`** (re-derive it) edited per **A**.
2. ⭐ **Verify the ledger needs no edit** — re-read `:948`–`:950` and confirm the entry's `why` does not quote the spelling. If it does, say so and stop: that is a claim on #6409's entry and changes this card's shape.
3. Re-run the measurement after the edit: the sentence must be true, and must **stay** true if `half-state-patrol.yml` is later normalised to `'22.x'`. That invariance is the whole point of A.
4. ⛔ **A zero-hit needs a control term.** The card's own control (the page's three `readme-exports.yml` references all resolve) is a good model — re-take it, don't inherit it.
5. Run the doc gates: `check-doc-links`, `check-doc-fence-languages`, `check-doc-snippet-types`, `check-control-bytes`, plus `scripts/__tests__/ci-cd-pipeline-doc.test.ts` and `doc-version-claims.test.ts` — this page is pinned bidirectionally by the first of those.
6. Changeset: docs-only ⇒ empty frontmatter expected.

## ⛔ Boundaries

- ⛔ **Do not touch `scripts/__tests__/doc-version-claims.test.ts`.** #6447 is dispatched in parallel and owns that file. If you find you *must* edit it, ⛔ stop and report — that is the collision case, and it changes both cards.
- ⛔ **One line.** Do not widen into the surrounding paragraph, the `@v7` claim, or the `pnpm/action-setup@v4` claim — all three measure **true**.
- ⛔ **Do not normalise `half-state-patrol.yml` to `'22.x'`.** That is a different change on a workflow this lane has an open card about (#5986), and it would make the fix untestable by removing the counter-example.
- ⛔ **Never edit `content/docs/releases/`.**
- ⚠️ ⛔ Re-derive every line number cited here. This page moves daily.

## ✅ ACCEPT — PR #7030. Verified from the diff, not from the report.

`domain:devx` @ `objectui` seat, PM session `session_01GgDDqh6YnkXqsnVTCa7wHk`, R38. Read at `c2c938d96`.

## The diff is exactly the disposition, and nothing else

```diff
-   now uses `@v7`, a hardcoded `node-version: 20` where every workflow declares `'22.x'`
+   now uses `@v7`, a hardcoded `node-version: 20` where every workflow declares 22
```

**Two files, 1 deletion, 26 insertions** — the one prose line plus a changeset. Every boundary held, checked by path rather than taken on trust:

| ⛔ boundary | result |
|:--|:--|
| `scripts/__tests__/doc-version-claims.test.ts` (#6447's file, running in parallel) | **untouched** ✅ |
| `.github/workflows/half-state-patrol.yml` (the counter-example) | **untouched** ✅ |
| `content/docs/releases/**` | **untouched** ✅ |
| the surrounding paragraph (`@v7`, `pnpm/action-setup@v4`) | **untouched** ✅ |

## ⭐ The invariance — the whole point of A — verified independently

Extracting every `node-version` **value** in `.github/workflows` at the PR head gives exactly two:

```
     29 '22.x'
      1 '22'
```

Control: the extractor returns 30 lines, so it is reading the directory rather than finding nothing and agreeing. ⇒ the old sentence was false by exactly one lane's **quoting**; the new one is true; and if `half-state-patrol.yml` is ever normalised the set becomes 30 × `'22.x'`, **still all major 22, sentence unchanged**. It is now insensitive to spelling, which is precisely what ⛔ option B would have thrown away.

## The ledger genuinely needed no edit — confirmed at the PR head

`doc-version-claims.test.ts:948-950`, #6409's entry, verbatim:

> *"…says in the same breath that every workflow declares **22** instead. Anchored on `.github/workflows`, where NO node-version declaration reads 20 and every one of them reads 22"*

Version-level, not spelling-level. ⇒ page and ledger now **agree**, and triage's *"never concurrent with #6409's entry work"* constraint was already satisfied because that entry has long since landed.

## ⭐ The card's own citation rotted AGAIN mid-dispatch — a better data point than the card had

| base | sentence at |
|:--|:--|
| card, `c8ea8af9c` (08-26) | 1744 |
| my claim comment, `f7850ee77` (13:12Z) | **1882** |
| the dev, `d3bf4fa6f` (14:11Z) | **1894** |

⚠️ Not a disagreement — **all three are correct for their base**. #7019 (`d42c2bee2`) landed *between my reading and the dev's*, adding 19 lines to this page and moving the sentence 12 more lines **in under half an hour**. ⭐ A card about facts that freeze had its own citation rot while it was being dispatched. That is #6998's thesis demonstrating itself, and it is why both my order and the dev's work re-derived rather than inherited.

## Verification

`check-doc-links` (17 scan roots) · `check-doc-fence-languages` · `check-control-bytes` (5833 tracked files) · `check-doc-snippet-types` (271/271 blocks, after building the 21 named packages — its initial exit 2 was an unbuilt fresh worktree, ⛔ not this diff) · `ci-cd-pipeline-doc.test.ts` **36/36** (this page's bidirectional pin) · `doc-version-claims.test.ts` **25/25** (untouched, per boundary). Control term re-taken rather than inherited: the page's three `readme-exports.yml` references all resolve to a workflow that exists.

**CI**: 28 checks, 27 terminal, **0 red**, 1 running. (28 rather than 29 — a docs-only diff drops `Bundle Analysis` and `Live E2E`.) Ready + auto-merge once every one is green — ⛔ not the required subset.
